test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following were the dwelling places used by Buddhist monks?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Viharas.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Chaitya**, **Vihara** and **Stupa**, all are parts of **Buddhist architecture** in India.
 
• **Viharas** were the **dwelling places** used by Buddhist monks. Viharas were built with the purpose of housing the monks.
 
• The plan of the Viharas consists of **a veranda, a hall and cells around the walls of the hall**. Some of the important vihara caves are** Ajanta cave No. 12, Bedsa cave No. 11, Nashik cave Nos. 3,10 and 17.**
 
• **Chaitya** was a **place of worship**. It was a rectangular prayer hall with a stupa placed in the center. **Karle Chaitya and Nashik Chaitya** are examples of famous Chaitya.
 
• The **Stupa** is a **ceremonial burial mound** used for the veneration of Buddhist saints. It is a **hemispherical structure**. **Sanchi Stupa and Bharhut Stupa** are examples of famous Stupas. 
 
• A Jain temple or **Derasar** is the **place of worship for Jains**, the followers of Jainism.
